title: VisualNeedle: Benchmarking Active Visual Search in Information-Dense Scenes
abstract: arXiv:2605.26380v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have been reported to achieve over 90\% accuracy on fine-grained perception benchmarks. However, such scores do not necessarily imply faithful use of visual evidence. Prior studies have identified three shortcuts that inflate benchmark performance. First, linguistic priors and lexical cues in questions often enable models to infer plausible answers without seeing the image. Second, coarse global semantics from the visual encoder can bypass fine-grained local details. Third, in some ``think-with-images'' benchmarks, corrupting the intermediate images returned by visual tools barely affects the final answer. These findings suggest that higher input resolution or larger question pools alone do not elicit genuine active visual search. To address this, we introduce VisualNeedle, a challenging, information-dense, and fine-grained benchmark for scenes where critical evidence is spatial

translated_title: VisualNeedle：面向信息密集场景的主动视觉搜索基准测试
translated_abstract: 据报道，前沿多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在细粒度感知基准上已达到超过90%的准确率。然而，这样的分数并不一定意味着模型对视觉证据的忠实使用。先前的研究已经识别出三种夸大基准性能的捷径。第一，问题中的语言先验和词汇线索往往使模型无需真正查看图像就能推断出看似合理的答案。第二，来自视觉编码器的粗糙全局语义可以绕过细粒度的局部细节。第三，在某些“以图思考”（think-with-images）基准中，破坏视觉工具返回的中间图像几乎不影响最终答案。这些发现表明，仅仅提高输入分辨率或扩大问题池并不能引发真正的主动视觉搜索。为解决这一问题，我们提出了VisualNeedle，一个具有挑战性、信息密集且细粒度的基准，针对关键证据在空间上（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出VisualNeedle基准，通过信息密集、细粒度的场景来检验多模态大语言模型是否真正进行主动视觉搜索，而非依赖语言先验等捷径夸大性能。
en_tdlr: VisualNeedle is a challenging, information-dense, and fine-grained benchmark designed to elicit genuine active visual search in multimodal LLMs, addressing shortcuts that inflate benchmark performance.
